# Appendix

The complete Mojo 1.0.0b1 [@MojoReleasesMojo] matrix multiplication implementation used throughout this
paper, including host setup, device memory allocation, and kernel dispatch, as
well as the full MLIR intermediate representations at each lowering stage
(linalg, affine, scf, and LLVM IR), are available in the accompanying
repository at \url{https://github.com/Jan-Kluger/mojo_mlir_seminar_mpcdf}.
